a.lede: A government watchdog is considering a probe into the Home Office’s use of ChatGPT technology to process asylum claims amid concerns over the tools’ accuracy and secrecy surrounding their use.
a.title: UK Home Office May Face Investigation Over Use of OpenAI Tech
